config_name: Aspire Go 15.6" — Ryzen 7 7730U, 16GB DDR4, 1TB SSD, FHD IPS

specs.ports: 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen2 (DP, 65W PD), 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen1, HDMI 1.4, 3.5mm
specs.keyboard_notes: Chiclet with numeric keypad, bilingual CA

battery.notes: 51.6 Wh verified. Zen 3 8-core runs warm in this thin shell: ~5-5.5h real, less under load.

offers.name: Acer Aspire Go 15.6" Laptop - Silver (AMD R7 7730/16GB RAM/1TB SSD/Windows 11)
Acer Aspire Go AG15-42P-R0CT-CA, 15.6" FHD Laptop, AMD Ryzen R7 7730U, 16GB DDR4, 1TB SSD, Windows 11

reviews.quote: Office notebook with long runtimes — very good battery runtimes and USB-C Power Delivery in a cheap 15.6-inch package.
This $300 laptop is a killer value and doesn't feel like a cheap laptop.
Nothing exciting, but it has clear value — a worthy machine for $300.

praises: Ryzen 7 7730U 8C/16T + 16GB is a genuinely capable multicore combo for $799.95 sale
1TB SSD standard — double the storage of every Intel twin at this price
Two full USB-C Gen2 ports both do DP video and 65W charging; easy dual-monitor setup
DDR4 SO-DIMM slots accept up to 32GB — real upgrade path
Vega 8 plays older and esports titles at 1080p low/medium, best gaming of the Aspire line
complaints: Fan is audible under almost any sustained load and the underside gets warm
Heaviest chassis of both families at 1.73 kg — you feel it in a backpack
Dull ~45% NTSC IPS panel with backlight glow in dark scenes
720p webcam, no IR, no keyboard backlight — camera/typing specs match the cheapest SKUs
Older Zen 3 platform: no NPU, so no Copilot+ features despite the Ryzen branding

standouts: Best multicore + 1TB storage combo of the Aspire family at sale price
Dual USB-C Gen2 ports (DP + PD on both) is a port-spec unusual at $799.95
design_philosophy: The AMD flagship of the Aspire Go 15: last-generation-but-capable Zen 3 silicon with 16GB/1TB in the pragmatic Aspire chassis — Acer's 'specs over polish' budget formula. Cooling, weight, and panel are where this config pays for the 8 cores and terabyte.
rating_notes: No pro review found for AG15 (see SHARED-aspire-go.md). Platform-anchored: 7730U known warm → thermals 5.0 and −0.5 battery vs cooler U chips despite 51.6Wh verified; +0.3 gaming for Vega 8 vs Iris-Xe-class on DDR4. 1.73 kg verified. Panel gamut/brightness are class estimates.
